ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-23-2014 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Harry M. Dorfman, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Mitch Lyon, #6840
Petitioners Youhan Chen and Li Fang ; father and mother of minor present in court.
Petitioners sworn and examined through Mandarine Interpreter James Roen.
Proof of Publication on file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minor from Xu Chen to Kevin Xu Chen.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of adult father: Youhan Chen to Stanley Chen.
Decree Changing Names signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-12-2013 Reset To Jan-23-14 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 514 For Order To Show Cause
